categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four business segments: AI large models and computing power, AI content security, digital intelligent energy, and digital intelligent government affairs. These segments encompass AI model development, AI hardware integration, content safety solutions, energy digitalization, and government digital services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include AI large model training and inference platforms, multi-modal content generation using Transformer and Diffusion architectures, AI computing power integration with proprietary AI all-in-one machines, AI content security systems, virtual power plant control technologies, and big data processing and analysis. The company emphasizes deep integration of AI software and hardware, zero-code automated model training, and secure AI application deployment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies at various levels, large and medium-sized enterprises, media organizations, energy groups, power grid companies, and AI startups. Major markets served are digital government, energy and power systems, media content production, judicial and legal sectors, and emerging AI application fields.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with offices in Guangdong (Dongguan), Beijing, and Chengdu. Its customer base and projects cover multiple Chinese regions including East China, South China, North China, Southwest, and Northwest China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the AI and digital technology supply chain, focusing on AI software development, AI hardware integration, and digital solutions deployment. It also engages in upstream activities such as data asset accumulation and AI model training infrastructure development.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing AI large model and computing power integration, expanding AI content security capabilities, developing virtual power plant platforms for new energy systems, and enhancing digital government services. R&D focuses on multi-modal AI models, AI all-in-one machines, AI security, big data analytics, and industry-specific AI applications. The company also emphasizes ecosystem building through academic and industry partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through product sales (AI software and hardware), SaaS subscription services (AI content security and big data SaaS), solution implementation and customization, and ongoing operation and maintenance services. The company also earns revenue from AI computing power leasing and virtual power plant operation service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading AI full-stack product and service provider in China, recognized for its AI large model capabilities and computing power integration. It competes with other AI and software firms specializing in large models and digital government solutions. It holds memberships and recognition in national AI and computing power industry alliances, indicating a strong competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 693.8 million, a 25.02% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 41.15 million, with a decrease compared to the previous year due to increased R&D investment and stock-based compensation. The company’s total assets grew by 13.34% to about RMB 2.09 billion, reflecting ongoing expansion and investment in AI and energy sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its full-stack AI technology integration, combining proprietary multi-modal large models with AI computing hardware for efficient deployment. Its AI content security platform ensures safe and compliant AI applications. The virtual power plant platform offers innovative energy management solutions aligned with national carbon goals. The company’s extensive data assets, industry-specific AI models, and zero-code application platforms provide customers with customizable, secure, and high-performance AI solutions tailored to diverse industry needs.
